title: archlock configuration
description: Configuration for archlock, a lockfile for your architecture.

sketchDir.description: Directory (relative to this file) that holds the .arch.py sketches.

include.description: Globs of source files archlock looks at (relative to this file).

exclude.description: Globs of source files to ignore. Test files are excluded by default.

maxTypeLength.description: Opt-in: types longer than this many characters are written to sketches as a placeholder with their first characters, length and a hash (e.g. '<"A-IM" | "Accept" | … (4635 chars, #9f247ce7)>'). check still detects any change. null (default) never abbreviates.

agent.description: Coding agent used by `archlock push`, `audit` and `init --with-summaries`.

command.description: Command template overriding the agent adapter. {prompt_file} is replaced with the path of the prompt file.

verifyCommands.description: Commands the agent may run during `archlock push` to verify its work, e.g. ["npm test", "npx tsc --noEmit"]. Each is allowed exactly and with extra arguments; the check command is always allowed and Claude Code refuses every other shell command. A test or build command lets the agent run code it wrote (edits are auto-accepted). No * ( ) , ; & | < > ` $.
